title.narrative: Sustaining Continuity of Wastewater Treatment Services within a Multiple Crisis contex

description.narrative:
SPECIFIC OBJECTIVE: Provision of essential public wastewater services is improved for Lebanese and refugee populations during a period of multiple crisis affecting the country

OUTCOMES:

Result 1.1: Water Establishments ensure continuity of wastewater services in the majority of the Lebanese territory

Result 1.2: Sustainable reforms for the sector are in place, including the promotion of reuse of treated wastewater

Result 1.3: Public Awareness about wastewater's impact on the environment is raised to promote a culture of payment for wastewater and water services
